steps.title: Allow this network
steps.text: Plain DNS only works for a network whose address you have claimed. Turn Plain DNS on for the Endpoint, then claim and prove this network's address on the Addresses page.

steps.title: Open the network settings
steps.text: Open System Settings, Network, your active connection and then Details.

steps.title: Add the addresses
steps.text: In DNS use the + button to add both addresses. The first one must be on top.

steps.title: For encryption
steps.text: Plain DNS is not encrypted. For encrypted DNS use Automatic Setup to build and install the Apple profile.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.text: A few seconds after saving, run this check to see that the device uses this Endpoint.
